note: XXV 112, Mina brings the typed pages (BK3M-1 take 0): Van Helsing clean-shaven, Mina's mark as the cross within a circle — 23 Nov

people.mina: Mina Harker: a young Englishwoman with dark hair

beats.text: Make the elderly man in spectacles on the right completely clean-shaven: remove all beard, stubble and moustache from his chin, jaw and lip, leaving smooth skin. Give the young dark-haired woman Mina's mark in place of the cross on her forehead: a small dark red mark in the centre of her forehead just above the brows, shaped exactly like the mark in the second reference image: a thin circle with an upright cross inside it whose arms touch the circle, the same size and colour. Keep both faces, her hair, the clothes, the papers, the light and the whole background exactly as they are.
